observed_failure: Numeric value mismatch for object Bodies: 'Sum: 6.06775878802135438e+00' vs 'Sum: 3.00021548081893457e+01'
finding: The fused CUDA step reads every body's position and writes new positions to the same global array without any synchronization across the reading and writing threads. A thread/block that finishes force accumulation early can overwrite positions still being read by other threads/blocks. At n=1031 each rank has a partial second CUDA block, exposing the pre-existing read/write race.
interpretation: Pre-existing CUDA correctness defect. Exclusive execution and internal finite-value validation succeed, but independent numerical validation fails. Retain failed external validation without retry.
investigation: Static source inspection and retained exclusive correctness output; no new program execution.
